password_setting.label: API key
password_setting.help: API key created in Metabase under Admin settings > Settings > Authentication > API Keys, assigned to the Administrators group.

base_url_setting.label: Self-hosted instance domain
base_url_setting.help: Required for self-hosted instances only. Must be publicly accessible via HTTPS only (e.g., example.com).

additional_config_fields.label: DNS alias
additional_config_fields.help: Required for cloud instances only. At least three characters: lowercase letters, numbers, and dashes.
